about_the_game:
The Bubbaruka! Soundtrack

This is the soundtrack to Bubbaruka, containing all the songs played in the game. There are 55 songs in total, Including the credits theme and both boss battle songs.

-----------

From: John

Subject: Bubbaruka Soundtrack

Hey, it's been a while!

Do you remember that weird game I emailed you a while back? I didn't play it all that much myself, it was kinda boring, and too incomplete to be a good virtual pet. I could barely remember to feed them. Haven't thought about it since. Until today.

This morning, when I turned on my computer, I found a strange ZIP file on my desktop.

It was called "Bubbaruka_Soundtrack".

It had all the songs I've heard in the game, but there's also a lot of other, scary sounding songs. You'd think it was the soundtrack of a horror game if you didn't know better. It had a text file inside, named "ForYou". I opened it up, and there it was. Your name, sitting on my desktop. Seriously, your name. Isn't that weird?

I thought that this must be for you, given... the obvious context clues. So, I figured I'd share it with you since it asked so nicely.

I don't know how it got on my desktop to begin with, but here it is. 

Attached: Bubbaruka_Soundtrack.zip

-----------

Contains music composed by Benjamin Schade, Ryan Fogleman, and David Steinmarck.
